name: Deltapoll
status_reason: Meets R1-R4. Pooled waves (weighted base usually 1.3-1.6x respondents, e.g. 2,773 v 2,023; 2.3x on 24-27 Jul) mean consecutive polls share respondents; the average should down-weight accordingly.
turnout_threshold: New turnout model (method note May 2026); tables base 'All adults in GB who intend to vote'
vi_options_table_order: Conservative ; Labour ; Liberal Democrat ; Reform UK ; Scottish National Party ; Plaid Cymru ; Green ; Other
